context_requirements: HSP90 client kinase dependence (ERBB2, EGFR, AKT, CDK4/6, mutant BRAF) for the antiproliferative arm
Intact or inducible HSF1-driven heat-shock response for the chaperone-induction arm
TP53 pathway competence for the senescence/apoptosis arm (A549, MCF7, HT29, HEPG2)
Active proliferation; quiescent or non-transformed lines (HA1E) respond weakly
falsifiers: No induction of HSPA1A, DNAJB1, HSPB1 or BAG3 at 6 h in any line
No depletion of MYC, CCND1, EGFR or ERBB2 at 6 h in ERBB2/EGFR-dependent lines
No G2/M or proliferation gene loss at 24 h
Stronger response in HA1E than in A549 or MCF7
Absence of any transcriptional change at both time points in all nine lines

evidence.supports: HSP90 inhibition blocks ERK/MAPK-dependent survival and is antiproliferative/pro-apoptotic in A549 NSCLC
HSP inhibitor suppresses HSP90AB4P and HSPB1 and sensitizes MCF-7/ADR breast cancer cells
HSP inhibitor quercetin suppresses Hsp27, Hsp70 and Hsp90 and induces apoptosis/DNA damage in MCF-7 and MDA-MB-231
HSP90 inhibitor 17AAG is used to overcome thermotolerance in triple-negative breast cancer
